name: Garry's Mod
description: Garry's Mod is a definitive physics sandbox powered by the Source engine. It offers ultimate freedom with no predefined goals — spawn props, build complex contraptions, and install thousands of community addons to run custom gamemodes like Sandbox, DarkRP, TTT, or your own unique creations.
author: SGC-NOVUS Tech
install_script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
## Server Files: /home/container
## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /home/container/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /home/container/steamcmd
mkdir -p /home/container/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /home/container/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /home/container
export HOME=/home/container

## install game using steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login ${STEAM_USER:-anonymous} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' || printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID:-4020} ${EXTRA_FLAGS} validate +quit

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /home/container/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /home/container/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## set up MySQLOO
echo "=== Установка последней версии MySQLOO ==="
mkdir -p /home/container/garrysmod/lua/bin
cd /home/container
LATEST_MYSQLOO=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/FredyH/MySQLOO/releases/latest | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name == "gmsv_mysqloo_linux.dll") | .browser_download_url')

if [ -n "$LATEST_MYSQLOO" ] && [ "$LATEST_MYSQLOO" != "null" ]; then
    curl -sL "$LATEST_MYSQLOO" -o /home/container/garrysmod/lua/bin/gmsv_mysqloo_linux.dll
    echo "MySQLOO успешно скачан и установлен."
else
    echo "Ошибка получения ссылки на MySQLOO."
fi

# Creating needed default files for the game
cd /home/container/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server
echo '-- Docs: https://wiki.garrysmod.com/page/resource/AddWorkshop
-- Place the ID of the workshop addon you want to be downloaded to people who join your server, not the collection ID
-- Use https://beta.configcreator.com/create/gmod/resources.lua to easily create a list based on your collection ID
resource.AddWorkshop( "" )' > workshop.lua

cd /home/container/garrysmod/cfg
echo '// Please do not set RCon, Hostname, Password, Region, Location or URLs in here; use the startup parameters in panel.

// Steam Server List Settings
sv_lan "0"
sv_max_queries_sec_global "30000"
sv_max_queries_window "45"
sv_max_queries_sec "5"

// Server Limits
sbox_maxprops       100
sbox_maxragdolls    5
sbox_maxnpcs        10
sbox_maxballoons    10
sbox_maxeffects     10
sbox_maxdynamite    10
sbox_maxlamps       10
sbox_maxthrusters   10
sbox_maxwheels      10
sbox_maxhoverballs  10
sbox_maxvehicles    20
sbox_maxbuttons     10
sbox_maxsents       20
sbox_maxemitters    5
sbox_godmode        0
sbox_noclip         0

// Network Settings - Please keep these set to default.
sv_minrate          75000
sv_maxrate          0
gmod_physiterations 2
net_splitpacket_maxrate 45000
decalfrequency      12

// Execute Ban Files - Please do not edit
exec banned_ip.cfg
exec banned_user.cfg

// Add custom lines under here' > server.cfg

client.name: Client Port
client.description: Port used by the game client to connect.

primary.name: Primary Port
primary.description: Primary server port used for connections and RCON.

reserve.name: Reserve Port
reserve.description: Reserve server port allocated in case of primary port issues or secondary services.

sourcetv.name: SourceTV Port
sourcetv.description: Port used for broadcasting matches via SourceTV.

variables.name: Server Hostname
variables.description: The public name of your server displayed in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password to protect the server. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password used for remote console access. Leave empty to completely disable RCON (Recommended for security).

variables.name: Steam Region
variables.description: The geographic region for the Steam master server browser.

variables.name: Server Location
variables.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) to display the correct flag in the server browser.

variables.name: Loading Screen URL
variables.description: Custom loading screen URL. Supports %s (SteamID64) and %m (map).

variables.name: FastDL URL
variables.description: HTTP(S) URL for FastDL to speed up custom content downloads.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The default map loaded when the server starts. Ensure the map is installed or included in Workshop.

variables.name: Game AppID (Client)
variables.description: AppID 4000 is the Garry's Mod client identifier. Used by panel auto-generators. Do not modify.

variables.name: Source AppID (Server)
variables.description: AppID 4020 is used by SteamCMD to download server files. Do not modify.

variables.name: Workshop ID
variables.description: The ID of your Steam Workshop collection (numbers at the end of the URL).

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: The default gamemode folder name (e.g., sandbox, darkrp, terrortown).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The maximum number of players allowed on the server.

variables.name: Tickrate
variables.description: Determines server updates per second. Default is 33. Higher values heavily load the CPU.

variables.name: Lua Refresh
variables.description: 1 to enable, 0 to disable Lua autorefresh (Disable on production to save resources).
